Now let me rebuild ss1c (robust version) and then angleC.

<<<RUN cwd=LeanEuclidPlus>>>
source ~/.venvs/leaneuclid/bin/activate; export PATH="$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH"; echo "===== ss1c ====="; timeout 300 lake build Book1.Prop47.ss1c > /tmp/ss1cR.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; echo "===== angleC ====="; timeout 400 lake build Book1.Prop47.angleC > /tmp/angleC6.log 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; grep -vE "trace:|LEAN_PATH|load-dynlib" /tmp/angleC6.log | grep -iE "error|unsolved|sorry|failed|mismatch|Built Book1.Prop47.angleC" | grep -vE "Prop[0-9]+/" | head -15; echo ALLDONE
<<<END>>>
